## Phase Breakdown: .NET 6 ? .NET 8 Upgrade

???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????
? Phase 1: Framework & Package Upgrade                    ??  2-4 hours   ?
???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????
?                                                                         ?
?  Step 1:  ? Validate .NET 8 SDK installation                          ?
?  Step 2:  ? Check global.json compatibility                           ?
?  Step 3:  ? Upgrade MyBills.Core ? net8.0                             ?
?           ?? Update caching packages to 8.0.x                          ?
?  Step 4:  ? Upgrade MyBills.Domain ? net8.0                           ?
?           ?? Keep Newtonsoft.Json temporarily                          ?
?  Step 5:  ? Upgrade MyBills.Data ? net8.0                             ?
?           ?? Update EF Core to 8.0.26                                  ?
?  Step 6:  ? Upgrade MyBills.Services ? net8.0                         ?
?  Step 7:  ? Upgrade MyBills.Mvc ? net8.0                              ?
?           ?? Update all web packages to 8.0.x                          ?
?  Step 8:  ? Build and validate                                         ?
?                                                                         ?
???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????
? Phase 2: JSON Serialization Migration                   ??  3-6 hours   ?
???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????
?                                                                         ?
?  Target: Replace Newtonsoft.Json ? System.Text.Json                    ?
?  Files:  10 entity files in MyBills.Domain\Entities                    ?
?                                                                         ?
?  ???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????      ?
?  ? Entities to Update:                                         ?      ?
?  ?  ? BiMonthlyRecurrence.cs                                   ?      ?
?  ?  ? BiWeeklyEvenRecurrence.cs                                ?      ?
?  ?  ? BiWeeklyOddRecurrence.cs                                 ?      ?
?  ?  ? BiYearlyRecurrence.cs                                    ?      ?
?  ?  ? DailyRecurrence.cs                                       ?      ?
?  ?  ? MonthlyRecurrence.cs                                     ?      ?
?  ?  ? OnetimeRecurrence.cs                                     ?      ?
?  ?  ? QuarterlyRecurrence.cs                                   ?      ?
?  ?  ? WeeklyRecurrence.cs                                      ?      ?
?  ?  ? YearlyRecurrence.cs                                      ?      ?
?  ???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????      ?
?                                                                         ?
?  Changes per file:                                                      ?
?    • Replace: using Newtonsoft.Json;                                   ?
?      With:    using System.Text.Json.Serialization;                    ?
?    • Replace: [JsonProperty("name")]                                   ?
?      With:    [JsonPropertyName("name")]                               ?
?    • Update any JsonConvert calls to JsonSerializer                    ?
?                                                                         ?
?  Final step: Remove Newtonsoft.Json package                            ?
?                                                                         ?
?  Expected benefit: 2-3x faster serialization! ??                       ?
?                                                                         ?

## Success Criteria Checklist

Framework Upgrade:
  ? All 5 projects targeting net8.0
  ? All NuGet packages updated to 8.x
  ? Clean build with no errors
  ? No EF Core migration issues

JSON Migration:
  ? Newtonsoft.Json removed
  ? System.Text.Json in use
  ? All 10 entity files updated
  ? Serialization tests passing
  ? 2-3x performance improvement verified

Nullable Types:
  ? Enabled in all 5 projects
  ? Zero nullable warnings
  ? Proper annotations throughout
  ? Compile-time null safety working

Testing:
  ? All existing tests passing
  ? No runtime null exceptions
  ? Database operations verified
  ? User flows tested

Deployment:
  ? Documentation updated
  ? Upgrade report generated
  ? Team briefed
  ? Rollback plan ready
